description: Cancel one of your bounties by ID. A canonical reason is required; details are required only for other. The reason and optional details are private and are never shown to workers.

details.description: Private explanation required only when reason is other. Maximum 500 characters.
details.title: maxLength(500)

reason.description: Why the owner is closing or cancelling the entire bounty.
